# DZ2022 empty-zone fill fixtures

Synthetic only. Exact money. Never present as real RoS sales.

- `rent_2011.csv` — small 2011 rent table (setting path in production; never commit real data).
- `ur6_dz2022.csv` — fixture stand-in for NRS SPD `Urban Rural 6 Fold 2022 Lookup.csv`.
- `weights.csv` — UPRN weight pairs covering unaffected / A / B / C / D / island / neighbour-borrow.
- `spine_councils.csv` — minimal code→la_code for both vintages used in the fixture.
